headline: Rwanda Women-Owned Exports Decline 51% Due to Financing Deficit
summary: Exports from women-owned enterprises in Rwanda dropped by 51%, according to a UN ECA and NISR report. Recommendations include enhancing access to trade financing to help firms move into higher-value processing.
why: Rwanda is a fast-growing East African economy aiming to strengthen its trade balance and private sector.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: A steep decrease in specialized commercial exports negatively affects national trade metrics.
